source: logistics.cpn (main page), derived 2026-08-27; dataset doi:10.5281/zenodo.8428084 (Knopp & Graves 2023, CC BY 4.0)
status: author-confirmed 2026-08-27 (Place in Stock position corrected per author + log); Reschedule position still open

Vehicle.note: no Reschedule ordering enforced: the model's Already-Departed variant lets a Reschedule event involve a vehicle after its Depart. (Book Vehicles, Load to Vehicle) is enforced per booking, not per vehicle object: a vehicle serving several transport documents interleaves later bookings with earlier loads, so Def. orders correctly reads the pair both-ways

Truck.note: cyclic resource; Load Truck < Drive to Terminal holds per tour, not per truck object

review_points: the main page's places are unnamed in the .cpn, so the Container chain is read off colorset flows (Container -> ContainerTruck -> Container -> ContainerForklift -> ...); the Place in Stock cycle (does a stocked container re-enter via Weigh or go to Load to Vehicle directly?) and the Reschedule position could not be pinned without place names
two transition variants each for Bring to Loading Bay and Reschedule Container (regular and Already-Departed); treated as one activity each
Set Status (full), Set Status (in transit), Go for Empty Container, customer order, vehicle, TERMINATE and the initializers do not appear in the log and are treated as silent
